fix: Fig BR.2 strip, The number: "RAX names the call (1 is write on x86-64 Linux); the arguments sit in RDI, RSI, RDX, R10, R8 and R9: Fig 3.4's order, with R10 in place of RCX, which SYSCALL overwrites."
